meta.title: Who Works at the Nature Park?

paragraphs: Posted by May: Who Works at the Nature Park? On Thursday, I sent five questions to Ranger Mark by email. He answered all of them in one evening. Teacher Kim read his answers before I wrote this post. Now Lily checks my words for the blog. Do you know who works in a park?

"The park has twenty staff," wrote Ranger Mark. "Ten of them are rangers, and five are cleaners." "Three people work in the office, and one is a designer." "The last one is an actor." The park is open from eight o'clock to five o'clock. Ranger Mark works there from Tuesday to Sunday.

The rangers look after nature and the environment. They walk the paths every morning, and they check the trees and the lake. "I also talk to visitors," wrote Ranger Mark. "I tell them about the animals and the plants." The cleaners start work at six o'clock in the morning. They clean the paths and the toilets, and they put paper and bottles in the bins.

"The designer makes the signs and the maps," wrote Ranger Mark. "He uses green and blue, because those are the colors of the park." The people in the office answer emails and phone calls. Last month, they answered more than two hundred emails. One of the emails was from me! I was very happy to read the answer. "The actor plays a tiger in a show for children," wrote Ranger Mark. "The show is every Sunday at eleven o'clock." The actor wears a big orange costume with black stripes. The tiger teaches the children to keep the park clean. After the show, every child gets a small picture card. It has a green flag on it, like the sign of our club.

Finally, I asked Ranger Mark about his favorite job in the park. "All our jobs are important," he answered. "The park needs every person, from the cleaner to the actor." I think that he is right. Which job in the park do you like? Write to me, and I will answer you.
text.summary: May writes a blog post about the people who work at the nature park. Ranger Mark answers her questions, and the post gives the numbers and the jobs of the twenty staff.
